//: Farm workspace root. The farm IS its own monorepo framework — Deno workspaces + a tiny affected orchestrator (tools/affected.mjs) — so there is NO Turborepo/Nx and NO node_modules. Packages below are workspace members; apps stay pure Deno (resolved at serve time by each index.html import map); CI verifies only the apps a change actually reaches.

tasks.gates: deno run -A packages/schema/validate.mjs apps/*/spec.json && deno run -A --import-map=packages/gates/preflight.importmap.json packages/gates/preflight.mjs apps/* && deno test -A packages/runtime/runtime_test.js && deno run -A deploy/sw.mjs --check && deno run -A deploy/counts.mjs --check

//gates: THE pre-push block, as one command. Running four of the five is how a stale service-worker manifest reached CI twice: the fifth is the one that depends on the LAST edit (an import graph changes when a view adopts a kit component), so it must run after everything else, every time.
